items.description: The magus can activate a wand or staff in place of casting a spell when using spell combat.

rulesData.text: The magus can activate a wand or staff in place of casting a spell when using spell combat.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Classes/Magus/Class Features/Magus Arcana/Wand Wielder

items.name: Beast Eye
items.description: The witch can project her senses into an animal within 100 feet, sensing whatever it senses.

rulesData.text: The witch can project her senses into an animal within 100 feet, sensing whatever it senses. She cannot control the animal's actions. She can project her senses from that animal to another within 100 feet of it as a standard action, and can continue to make these sensory leaps, potentially viewing things very far from her actual location. She may return her senses to her own body as a free action. Normal animals get no saving throw against this ability, but animal companions, paladin mounts, and similar unusual animals may resist with a Will save; the witch may use this ability on her own familiar as if it were an animal. If the witch has the coven hex, all other witches within 10 feet of her who also have the coven hex can see through this animal at will, although the acting witch still controls the ability. The witch can use this ability for a number of minutes per day equal to her level. These minutes need not be consecutive, but they must be spent in 1-minute increments.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Witch/Major Hexes/Beast Eye

items.name: Cook People
items.description: The witch can create fabulous spells by cooking an intelligent humanoid creature in her cauldron, either alive or dead.

rulesData.text: The witch can create fabulous spells by cooking an intelligent humanoid creature in her cauldron, either alive or dead. Using this hex creates one meal or serving of food of the witch's choice, typically a delicious stew or a dough suitable for cookies, pastries, or other desserts. Cooking the victim takes 1 hour. Eating the food provides one of the following benefits for 1 hour: age resistance , bear's endurance , bull's strength , cat's grace , eagle's splendor , fox's cunning , neutralize poison (instantaneous) owl's wisdom, remove disease (instantaneous). Alternatively, the witch can shape the dough into a Small, humanlike creature, animating it as a homunculus for 1 hour. The witch must have the cauldron hex to select this hex. Using this hex or knowingly eating its food is an evil act.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Witch/Major Hexes/Cook People

items.name: Hidden Home
items.description: The witch can conceal or disguise her home and the area around it as if using mirage arcana .

rulesData.text: The witch can conceal or disguise her home and the area around it as if using mirage arcana . Before using the hex, she must spend 1 day pacing out the border of an area that measures roughly 40,000 square feet (approximately 200 feet by 200 feet) to define her home territory. Thereafter, she can use the hex to change the appearance of that area as a standard action as long as she is within the area. The illusion persists until the witch changes or dismisses it. For the purpose of this ability, a witch can only have one “home” at a time.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Witch/Major Hexes/Hidden Home

items.name: Hoarfrost
items.description: The target is rimed with a shell of frost needles that slowly work their way into its flesh (Fortitude negates).

rulesData.text: The target is rimed with a shell of frost needles that slowly work their way into its flesh (Fortitude negates). The target turns pale and blue, and takes 1 point of Constitution damage per minute until it dies, saves (once per minute), or is cured. Break enchantment , dispel magic , remove curse , and similar spells end the effect. If the target saves, it is immune to this hex for 1 day. This is a cold effect.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Witch/Major Hexes/Hoarfrost

items.name: Ice Tomb
items.description: A storm of ice and freezing wind envelops the target, which takes 3d8 points of cold damage (Fortitude half).

rulesData.text: A storm of ice and freezing wind envelops the target, which takes 3d8 points of cold damage (Fortitude half). If the target fails its save, it is paralyzed and unconscious but does not need to eat or breathe while the ice lasts. The ice has 20 hit points; destroying the ice frees the creature, which is staggered for 1d4 rounds after being released. Whether or not the target's saving throw is successful, it cannot be the target of this hex again for 1 day.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Witch/Major Hexes/Ice Tomb

items.name: Infected Wounds
items.description: The target's wounds become infected (Fortitude negates).

rulesData.text: The target's wounds become infected (Fortitude negates). The target takes 1 point of Constitution damage per day. After the first day, the target may save once per day to cure the infection. This is a disease effect.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Witch/Major Hexes/Infected Wounds

items.name: Speak in Dreams
items.description: The witch can contact a creature as if using dream .

rulesData.text: The witch can contact a creature as if using dream . The witch can use this ability on a number of creatures per day equal to her Intelligence bonus, but can dream-speak to those creatures as often as desired throughout that time period.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Witch/Major Hexes/Speak in Dreams

items.name: Witch's Brew
items.description: When the witch uses her cauldron to brew a potion, she may spend double the cost to create 2 identical potions that day instead of just 1.

rulesData.text: When the witch uses her cauldron to brew a potion, she may spend double the cost to create 2 identical potions that day instead of just 1. At 15th level, she may spend triple the cost to create 3 identical potions that day. The witch must have the cauldron hex to select this hex.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Witch/Major Hexes/Witchs Brew

items.name: Summoning Mastery
items.description: Starting at 1st level, a master summoner can cast summon monster I as a spell-like ability a number of times per day equal to 5 + his Charisma modifier.

rulesData.text: Starting at 1st level, a master summoner can cast summon monster I as a spell-like ability a number of times per day equal to 5 + his Charisma modifier. The summoner can use this ability when his eidolon is summoned. Only one summon monster spell may be in effect while the eidolon is summoned. If the summoner's eidolon is not summoned, the number of creatures that can be summoned with this ability is only limited by its uses per day. This ability otherwise functions as the summoner's normal summon monster I ability. Other than these restrictions, there is no limit to how many summon monster or gate spells the summoner can have active at one time. This ability replaces the summoner's normal summon monster I ability and shield ally.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Summoner/Summoner Archetypes/Master Summoner/Summoning Mastery

items.name: Empty Body
items.description: At 13th level, a menhir savant can become ethereal as a standard action, as if using ethereal jaunt .

rulesData.text: At 13th level, a menhir savant can become ethereal as a standard action, as if using ethereal jaunt . She can remain ethereal for a number of rounds per day equal to her druid level. These rounds do not need to be consecutive. This ability replaces a thousand faces.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Druid/Druid Archetypes/Menhir Savant/Empty Body

items.name: Place Magic
items.description: At 2nd level, a menhir savant learns to identify and tap into ley lines in different types of terrain.

rulesData.text: At 2nd level, a menhir savant learns to identify and tap into ley lines in different types of terrain. As a free action, she can tap into the magic of a nearby ley line and increase her caster level by +1 for 1 round. She can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + her Wisdom bonus. This ability replaces woodland stride and trackless step.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Druid/Druid Archetypes/Menhir Savant/Place Magic

items.name: Spirit Sense
items.description: At 1st level, a menhir savant can detect the presence of undead; fey; outsiders; and astral, ethereal, or incorporeal creatures.

rulesData.text: At 1st level, a menhir savant can detect the presence of undead; fey; outsiders; and astral, ethereal, or incorporeal creatures. This ability functions like detect undead , and the druid detects all of these creatures rather than trying to detect one kind. This ability replaces nature sense and wild empathy.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Druid/Druid Archetypes/Menhir Savant/Spirit Sense

items.name: Walk the Lines
items.description: At 9th level, a menhir savant can use her connection to ley lines to cast transport via plants a number of times per day equal to her Wisdom bonus.

rulesData.text: At 9th level, a menhir savant can use her connection to ley lines to cast transport via plants a number of times per day equal to her Wisdom bonus.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Druid/Druid Archetypes/Menhir Savant/Walk the Lines

items.name: Iron Skin
items.description: You gain a +2 armor bonus to your Armor Class for 10 minutes; this bonus increases by +1 for every 5 caster levels (maximum +6 at 20th level).

rulesData.text: You gain a +2 armor bonus to your Armor Class for 10 minutes; this bonus increases by +1 for every 5 caster levels (maximum +6 at 20th level). You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Intelligence bonus.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Wizard/Elemental Wizard Schools/Metal/Iron Skin

items.name: Metal Rending
items.description: At 20th level, whenever you cast a spell on a creature made of metal or wearing medium or heavy armor, you can roll twice to penetrate the creature's spell resistance and take the better result.

rulesData.text: At 20th level, whenever you cast a spell on a creature made of metal or wearing medium or heavy armor, you can roll twice to penetrate the creature's spell resistance and take the better result.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Wizard/Elemental Wizard Schools/Metal/Metal Rending

items.name: Shrapnel Burst
items.description: At 8th level, as a swift action, you can cause jagged pieces of metal to explode outward from your body.

rulesData.text: At 8th level, as a swift action, you can cause jagged pieces of metal to explode outward from your body. These shards deal 1d6 points of piercing damage per two wizard levels (minimum 1d6) to all creatures within a 10-foot-radius burst. A Reflex save halves this damage. In addition, the twisted scraps of metal make the area difficult terrain until your next turn (at which time they disappear). You can use this ability once per day, plus one additional time per day at 13th and 18th level. At 10th-level, the shrapnel bypasses damage reduction as if it were a magic weapon.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Wizard/Elemental Wizard Schools/Metal/Shrapnel Burst

items.name: Monkey Athletics
items.description: As a free action, you may add a competence bonus equal to half your druid level (minimum of +1) on one Acrobatics, Climb, Disable Device, or Sleight of Hand check.

rulesData.text: As a free action, you may add a competence bonus equal to half your druid level (minimum of +1) on one Acrobatics, Climb, Disable Device, or Sleight of Hand check. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Druid/Animal and Terrain Domains/Monkey Domain/Monkey Athletics

items.name: Ranged Legerdemain
items.description: At 6th level, you can use the Disable Device and Sleight of Hand skills at a range of 30 feet.

rulesData.text: At 6th level, you can use the Disable Device and Sleight of Hand skills at a range of 30 feet. Working at a distance increases the normal skill check DC by 5, and you cannot take 10 on this check. Any object to be manipulated must weigh 5 pounds or less. You can only use this ability if you have at least 1 rank in the skill being used.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Druid/Animal and Terrain Domains/Monkey Domain/Ranged Legerdemain

items.name: Night Sight
items.description: At 2nd level, a mooncaller gains low-light vision.

rulesData.text: At 2nd level, a mooncaller gains low-light vision. If she already has low-light vision, she gains darkvision with a range of 30 feet. If she already has darkvision, the range of her darkvision is increased by 30 feet. This ability replaces woodland stride.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Druid/Druid Archetypes/Mooncaller/Night Sight

items.name: Purity of Body
items.description: At 9th level, a mooncaller gains immunity to all diseases, including supernatural and magical diseases.

rulesData.text: At 9th level, a mooncaller gains immunity to all diseases, including supernatural and magical diseases. This ability replaces venom immunity.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Druid/Druid Archetypes/Mooncaller/Purity of Body

items.name: Resist Call of the Wild
items.description: At 4th level, a mooncaller gains a +4 bonus on saving throws to avoid confusion, daze, feeblemind, and insanity effects.

rulesData.text: At 4th level, a mooncaller gains a +4 bonus on saving throws to avoid confusion, daze, feeblemind, and insanity effects. She also gains a +4 bonus against the exceptional, spell-like, and supernatural abilities of creatures with the shapechanger subtype. This ability replaces resist nature's lure.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Druid/Druid Archetypes/Mooncaller/Resist Call of the Wild

items.name: Wolfsbane
items.description: At 13th level, a mooncaller gains DR 3/silver, increasing to DR 4/silver at 16th level and DR 5/silver at 19th level.

rulesData.text: At 13th level, a mooncaller gains DR 3/silver, increasing to DR 4/silver at 16th level and DR 5/silver at 19th level. This ability replaces a thousand faces.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Druid/Druid Archetypes/Mooncaller/Wolfsbane

items.name: Foothold
items.description: As a standard action, you can cause an adjacent stone surface up to 10 feet square to mold itself into ridges and creases.

rulesData.text: As a standard action, you can cause an adjacent stone surface up to 10 feet square to mold itself into ridges and creases. A foothold that is created on a horizontal surface is treated as difficult terrain, and a Medium or smaller creature standing in the area or moving through it takes a –2 penalty on Acrobatics checks and to CMD due to poor footing. A foothold that is created on a vertical surface grants a +10 bonus on Climb checks to climb it. The stone remains altered for 1 hour. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Druid/Animal and Terrain Domains/Mountain Domain/Foothold

items.name: Thin Air
items.description: At 8th level, as a free action, you can surround yourself with a 5-foot aura of supernaturally thin air that draws the breath from creatures adjacent to you.

rulesData.text: At 8th level, as a free action, you can surround yourself with a 5-foot aura of supernaturally thin air that draws the breath from creatures adjacent to you. Creatures beginning their turn in the aura are fatigued (Fortitude negates). A fatigued creature that begins its turn in the aura must save or suffer from altitude sickness, taking 1 point of ability damage to all ability scores. At 16th level, the aura increases to 10 feet. Creatures that do not breathe are immune to this aura. You can use this ability for a number of rounds per day equal to your druid level; the rounds need not be consecutive.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Druid/Animal and Terrain Domains/Mountain Domain/Thin Air

items.name: Aura of Purity
items.description: At 3rd level, you gain a +4 sacred bonus on saves against spells and effects from creatures of the aberration type.

rulesData.text: At 3rd level, you gain a +4 sacred bonus on saves against spells and effects from creatures of the aberration type. Allies within 10 feet gain a +1 sacred bonus on these saves. This ability functions only while the paladin is conscious, not if she is unconscious or dead. This ability replaces aura of courage.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Paladin/Paladin Archetypes/Oathbound Paladin/Oaths/Oath against Corruption/Aura of Purity

items.name: Cast into the Void
items.description: At 20th level, a paladin becomes a conduit for the power of her god.

rulesData.text: At 20th level, a paladin becomes a conduit for the power of her god. Her DR increases to 10/evil. Whenever she uses smite evil and successfully strikes an aberration, the creature must make a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 the paladin's level + the paladin's Charisma modifier) or be banished to oblivion. This ability does not kill the creature, but it is sent to a remote place, such as deep underground or far into space (if it is a creature native to space), and cannot return under its own power for at least 100 years. Whenever the paladin channels positive energy or uses lay on hands to heal a creature, she heals the maximum possible amount. This ability replaces holy champion.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Paladin/Paladin Archetypes/Oathbound Paladin/Oaths/Oath against Corruption/Cast into the Void

items.name: Cleansing Flame
items.description: At 11th level, you may expend two uses of your smite evil ability to ignite your weapon with a cleansing blue flame for 1 minute.

rulesData.text: At 11th level, you may expend two uses of your smite evil ability to ignite your weapon with a cleansing blue flame for 1 minute. This flame sheds light as a torch. Aberrations within 20 feet of the flame take a –4 penalty on attack rolls against you and your allies, and your allies within 20 feet of the flame gain a +2 sacred bonus on saving throws against spells and effects from aberrations. This ability replaces aura of justice.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Paladin/Paladin Archetypes/Oathbound Paladin/Oaths/Oath against Corruption/Cleansing Flame

items.name: Anchoring Aura
items.description: At 8th level, a paladin's aura hampers extradimensional travel by evil outsiders.

rulesData.text: At 8th level, a paladin's aura hampers extradimensional travel by evil outsiders. The aura extends 20 feet from the paladin. Evil outsiders attempting to use abilities such as dimension door , plane shift , or teleport to leave or enter the aura must succeed at a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 the paladin's level + the paladin's Charisma modifier); failure means the ability does not function, as if the outsider were affected by dimensional anchor . The aura functions only while the paladin is conscious, not if she is unconscious or dead. Alternatively, as an immediate action, the paladin can expend one use of her smite evil ability to target an evil outsider within 30 feet with dimensional anchor . A targeted dimensional anchor persists even if the paladin is unconscious or dead. This ability replaces aura of resolve.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Paladin/Paladin Archetypes/Oathbound Paladin/Oaths/Oath against Fiends/Anchoring Aura

items.name: Holy Vessel
items.description: At 9th level, a paladin whose divine bond is with a weapon can also use her divine bond to augment her armor or shield with enhancement bonuses, or add any of the following armor or shield properties: bashing , fortification , and spell resistance .

rulesData.text: At 9th level, a paladin whose divine bond is with a weapon can also use her divine bond to augment her armor or shield with enhancement bonuses, or add any of the following armor or shield properties: bashing , fortification , and spell resistance . Adding these properties consumes an amount of bonus equal to the property's cost (see the armor special abilities and shield special abilities tables). She can divide her bonuses from the divine bond ability among her weapon, armor, and shield as she sees fit. This ability has no effect for a paladin whose divine bond is with a mount. This ability replaces the mercy gained at 9th level.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Paladin/Paladin Archetypes/Oathbound Paladin/Oaths/Oath against Fiends/Holy Vessel

items.name: Holy Reach
items.description: At 2nd level, an oathbound paladin can expend one use of her smite evil ability to extend her natural reach by 5 feet for 1 minute.

rulesData.text: At 2nd level, an oathbound paladin can expend one use of her smite evil ability to extend her natural reach by 5 feet for 1 minute. This does not stack with the Lunge feat. This ability replaces divine grace.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Paladin/Paladin Archetypes/Oathbound Paladin/Oaths/Oath against Savagery/Holy Reach

items.name: Hordebreaker
items.description: At 11th level, when the paladin hits an evil humanoid with an attack of opportunity, she deals an additional 1d6 points of damage.

rulesData.text: At 11th level, when the paladin hits an evil humanoid with an attack of opportunity, she deals an additional 1d6 points of damage. When using holy reach, the paladin may make a number of additional attacks of opportunity per round equal to her Charisma bonus. This increase stacks with similar increases from other sources such as Combat Reflexes. This ability replaces aura of justice.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Paladin/Paladin Archetypes/Oathbound Paladin/Oaths/Oath against Savagery/Hordebreaker

items.name: Aura of Life
items.description: At 8th level, the paladin gains a +4 morale bonus on saves against attacks that grant negative levels and saves to overcome negative levels.

rulesData.text: At 8th level, the paladin gains a +4 morale bonus on saves against attacks that grant negative levels and saves to overcome negative levels. Each ally within 10 feet of her gains a +2 morale bonus on these saves. This ability functions only while the paladin is conscious, not if she is unconscious or dead. This ability replaces aura of resolve.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Paladin/Paladin Archetypes/Oathbound Paladin/Oaths/Oath against Undeath/Aura of Life

items.name: Detect Undead
items.description: This ability works like the standard paladin ability to detect evil, except as detect undead instead of detect evil .

rulesData.text: This ability works like the standard paladin ability to detect evil, except as detect undead instead of detect evil . This ability replaces detect evil .
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Paladin/Paladin Archetypes/Oathbound Paladin/Oaths/Oath against Undeath/Detect Undead

items.name: Ghost Touch Aura
items.description: At 3rd level, the paladin's armor is treated as if it had the ghost touch armor property.

rulesData.text: At 3rd level, the paladin's armor is treated as if it had the ghost touch armor property. This does not affect the cost or effect of any other abilities of the armor. At 9th level, this ability also applies to the paladin's shield. This ability replaces the paladin's 3rd-level and 9th-level mercies.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Paladin/Paladin Archetypes/Oathbound Paladin/Oaths/Oath against Undeath/Ghost Touch Aura

items.name: Superior Channeler
items.description: At 11th level, a paladin can channel positive energy to harm undead by expending a single usage of her lay on hands ability instead of two.

rulesData.text: At 11th level, a paladin can channel positive energy to harm undead by expending a single usage of her lay on hands ability instead of two. This ability replaces aura of justice.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Paladin/Paladin Archetypes/Oathbound Paladin/Oaths/Oath against Undeath/Superior Channeler

items.name: Breath Evasion
items.description: At 4th level, a paladin with this oath gains evasion, but only against the breath weapons of creatures with the dragon type.

rulesData.text: At 4th level, a paladin with this oath gains evasion, but only against the breath weapons of creatures with the dragon type. This ability replaces channel positive energy.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Paladin/Paladin Archetypes/Oathbound Paladin/Oaths/Oath against the Wyrm/Breath Evasion

items.name: Divine Bond
items.description: This works like the paladin's normal divine bond ability, except as follows.

rulesData.text: This works like the paladin's normal divine bond ability, except as follows. If the paladin's bond is with a weapon, she cannot use that ability to add the brilliant energy , disruption , or merciful weapon properties, but she can add the bane weapon property (but only against dragons). If the paladin's bond is with her steed, the steed gains the paladin's aura-based immunities and her aura does not affect allies. This replaces the standard divine bond ability.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Paladin/Paladin Archetypes/Oathbound Paladin/Oaths/Oath against the Wyrm/Divine Bond

items.name: Dragon-Slaying Strike
items.description: At 20th level, an oathbound paladin becomes a conduit of holy power.

rulesData.text: At 20th level, an oathbound paladin becomes a conduit of holy power. Her DR increases to 10/evil. Whenever she uses smite evil and successfully strikes a dragon, the dragon is also subject to a single-target holy word , using her paladin level +10 as the caster level. After the banishment effect and the damage from the attack are resolved, the smite immediately ends. In addition, whenever she channels positive energy or uses lay on hands to heal a creature, she heals the maximum possible amount. This ability replaces holy champion.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Paladin/Paladin Archetypes/Oathbound Paladin/Oaths/Oath against the Wyrm/Dragon-Slaying Strike

items.name: Charitable Hands
items.description: At 2nd level, a paladin with this oath heals 50% less when she uses lay on hands on herself, but 50% more than the normal amount when she uses it to heal others.

rulesData.text: At 2nd level, a paladin with this oath heals 50% less when she uses lay on hands on herself, but 50% more than the normal amount when she uses it to heal others. Using lay on hands to harm undead deals the normal amount of damage. This ability otherwise works like and replaces lay on hands.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Paladin/Paladin Archetypes/Oathbound Paladin/Oaths/Oath of Charity/Charitable Hands

items.name: Charitable Mercy
items.description: At 5th level, a paladin with this oath is more flexible with her mercies than other paladins.

rulesData.text: At 5th level, a paladin with this oath is more flexible with her mercies than other paladins. At the start of each day, a paladin with this oath can select her mercies anew from the list of available mercies. This ability replaces divine bond.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Paladin/Paladin Archetypes/Oathbound Paladin/Oaths/Oath of Charity/Charitable Mercy

items.name: Pure of Body
items.description: Upon reaching 8th level, the paladin has a 50% chance to turn any critical hit or sneak attack against her into a normal hit, as if she were wearing fortification armor.

rulesData.text: Upon reaching 8th level, the paladin has a 50% chance to turn any critical hit or sneak attack against her into a normal hit, as if she were wearing fortification armor. This ability replaces aura of resolve.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Paladin/Paladin Archetypes/Oathbound Paladin/Oaths/Oath of Chastity/Pure of Body

items.name: Pure of Mind
items.description: At 2nd level, the paladin gains a +4 sacred bonus on saves against charm effects and figments, and gains a bonus equal to her Charisma modifier on Will saving throws.

rulesData.text: At 2nd level, the paladin gains a +4 sacred bonus on saves against charm effects and figments, and gains a bonus equal to her Charisma modifier on Will saving throws. This ability replaces divine grace.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Paladin/Paladin Archetypes/Oathbound Paladin/Oaths/Oath of Chastity/Pure of Mind

items.name: Loyal Guardian
items.description: At 8th level, whenever the target of the paladin's loyal oath is hit with a melee or ranged attack, if the paladin is adjacent to the target, she can spend an immediate action to have the attack automatically hit her instead of the intended target.

rulesData.text: At 8th level, whenever the target of the paladin's loyal oath is hit with a melee or ranged attack, if the paladin is adjacent to the target, she can spend an immediate action to have the attack automatically hit her instead of the intended target. This ends the loyal oath.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Paladin/Paladin Archetypes/Oathbound Paladin/Oaths/Oath of Loyalty/Loyal Guardian

items.name: Loyal Oath
items.description: Starting at 1st level, once per day as a swift action, an oathbound paladin can choose a willing creature within line of sight as the target of her loyal oath.

rulesData.text: Starting at 1st level, once per day as a swift action, an oathbound paladin can choose a willing creature within line of sight as the target of her loyal oath. When the paladin is adjacent to the target of her loyal oath, she grants the target a sacred bonus on saving throws and to Armor Class equal to the paladin's Charisma bonus. The loyal oath lasts 1 minute, or until the paladin dismisses it (a free action) or discharges it (see below), whichever comes first. If the target is struck by an enemy and the paladin is adjacent to that enemy, as an immediate action she may make a single melee attack against that enemy; making this attack ends the loyal oath. At 4th level and every three levels thereafter, the paladin may use her loyal oath one additional time per day. This ability replaces smite evil.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Paladin/Paladin Archetypes/Oathbound Paladin/Oaths/Oath of Loyalty/Loyal Oath

items.name: Channel Wrath
items.description: When an oathbound paladin reach 4th level, she can spend two uses of her lay on hands ability to gain an extra use of smite evil that day.

rulesData.text: When an oathbound paladin reach 4th level, she can spend two uses of her lay on hands ability to gain an extra use of smite evil that day. This ability has no effect for a paladin who does not have the smite evil ability. This ability replaces channel positive energy.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Paladin/Paladin Archetypes/Oathbound Paladin/Oaths/Oath of Vengeance/Channel Wrath

items.name: Powerful Justice
items.description: At 11th level, an oathbound paladin may spends one use of her smite evil ability to grant her allies within 10 feet the ability to smite evil, except they only gain the paladin's bonus to damage, not her smite's attack bonus or ability to bypass DR.

rulesData.text: At 11th level, an oathbound paladin may spends one use of her smite evil ability to grant her allies within 10 feet the ability to smite evil, except they only gain the paladin's bonus to damage, not her smite's attack bonus or ability to bypass DR. This ability replaces aura of justice.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Paladin/Paladin Archetypes/Oathbound Paladin/Oaths/Oath of Vengeance/Powerful Justice

items.name: Improved Empathic Link
items.description: The pack lord gains an empathic link with all of her animal companions.

rulesData.text: The pack lord gains an empathic link with all of her animal companions. This functions like an empathic link with a familiar. In addition, as a swift action the pack lord can shift her perception to one of her companions, allowing her to experience what it sees, hears, and so on. She can maintain this connection as long as she likes (as long as the companion is within 1 mile) and end it as a free action. The druid can only use this ability on one companion at a time, and cannot see, hear, or smell with her own body while maintaining this connection. This ability replaces the 6th-level additional use of wild shape.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Druid/Druid Archetypes/Pack Lord/Improved Empathic Link

items.name: Pack Bond
items.description: A pack lord druid may not select a domain and must choose an animal companion.

rulesData.text: A pack lord druid may not select a domain and must choose an animal companion. The druid gains a +2 bonus on wild empathy and Handle Animal checks made regarding her animal companion. The pack lord may have more than one animal companion, but she must divide up her effective druid level between her companions to determine the abilities of each companion. For example, a 4th-level pack lord can have one 4th-level companion, two 2nd-level companions, or one 1st-level and one 3rd-level companion. Each time a pack lord's druid level increases, she must decide how to allocate the increase among her animal companions (including the option of adding a new 1st-level companion). Once a druid level is allocated to a particular companion, it cannot be redistributed while that companion is in the pack lord's service (she must release the companion or wait until the companion dies to allocate its levels to another companion, which she can do the next time she prepares spells). The share spells animal companion ability only applies to one animal companion at a time—the pack lord cannot use it to cast a one-target spell and have it affect all of her animal companions. This ability replaces nature bond.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Druid/Druid Archetypes/Pack Lord/Pack Bond

items.name: Migrating Herd
items.description: When you summon an aurochs, bison, elephant, horse, mastodon, pony, or similar quadruped herbivore with a summoning spell, the duration of the spell is increased by 100% (this does not stack with Extend Spell).

rulesData.text: When you summon an aurochs, bison, elephant, horse, mastodon, pony, or similar quadruped herbivore with a summoning spell, the duration of the spell is increased by 100% (this does not stack with Extend Spell). The creature's land speed is increased by 10 feet.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Druid/Animal and Terrain Domains/Plains Domain/Migrating Herd

items.name: Pounce
items.description: At 6th level, you may use the pounce special attack once per day.

rulesData.text: At 6th level, you may use the pounce special attack once per day. You may pounce one additional time per day for every 3 levels after 6th.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Druid/Animal and Terrain Domains/Plains Domain/Pounce

items.name: Determination
items.description: At 3rd level, the preacher is a person of few words on the battlefield, but those words hold great power and authority.

rulesData.text: At 3rd level, the preacher is a person of few words on the battlefield, but those words hold great power and authority. Once per day, the inquisitor can use this ability to create one of the following effects. Each is a free action to use.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Inquisitor/Inquisitor Archetypes/Preacher/Determination

items.name: Alchemical Protection
items.description: The alchemical knowledge granted by this book protects you from poisons and alchemical items.

rulesData.text: The alchemical knowledge granted by this book protects you from poisons and alchemical items. Spend this boon's effect as an immediate action when you make a saving throw against poison or an alchemical item but before rolling the saving throw. You gain a +4 bonus on that saving throw.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Mastering Magic/Spellbooks/Spellbooks/Lab Journal of Constance Inflix (Level 5 Alchemist)/Preparation Ritual/Alchemical Protection

items.name: Beastly Concoction
items.description: This journal grants you the ability to make an extremely potent and savage mutagen.

rulesData.text: This journal grants you the ability to make an extremely potent and savage mutagen. Spend this boon when you imbibe your mutagen. The mutagen grants you a +6 alchemical bonus to your selected ability score instead of the normal +4; you take a –2 penalty to all of your mental ability scores (Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma) while the mutagen is in effect.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Mastering Magic/Spellbooks/Spellbooks/Journal of the Beast Within (Level 10 Alchemist)/Preparation Ritual/Beastly Concoction

items.name: Breath of the Grave
items.description: As a swift action, spend this boon's effect to breathe a 15-foot cone of rotting stench.

rulesData.text: As a swift action, spend this boon's effect to breathe a 15-foot cone of rotting stench. Creatures within the cone must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw (DC 10 + your highest caster level in a class that prepares spells) or be sickened for 1 round. This spends the boon. After this boon has been spent, you take a –4 penalty on Diplomacy and Stealth checks until you prepare spells again.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Mastering Magic/Spellbooks/Spellbooks/Book of the Grave (Level 6 Necromancer)/Preparation Ritual/Breath of the Grave

items.name: Curse of Names
items.description: When you are finished preparing your spells with this book, write the proper name of a single creature among the list of names in this book.

rulesData.text: When you are finished preparing your spells with this book, write the proper name of a single creature among the list of names in this book. As a swift action, when you are within 30 feet of the named creature, you can call out its name to bestow the curse of names on it. This spends the boon's effect. The target creature takes a –2 penalty on all attack rolls, and a –4 penalty on all attack rolls against you, for 1 minute. When you activate this curse, the name is crossed out in the back of the book. That creature cannot be the target of a curse of names originating from you ever again. The penalties of two instances of curse of names on the same creature do not stack.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Mastering Magic/Spellbooks/Spellbooks/Mastery of Word and Thought (Level 20 Enchanter)/Preparation Ritual/Curse of Names

items.name: Defensive Boon
items.description: You throw up a quick burst of arcane energy that deflects an incoming spell attack.

rulesData.text: You throw up a quick burst of arcane energy that deflects an incoming spell attack. As an immediate action when targeted with a touch spell or spell-like ability, you can spend this boon's effect to gain a +4 deflection bonus to AC against the triggering attack.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Mastering Magic/Spellbooks/Spellbooks/Library of the Dancer of Skins (Level 19 Universalist)/Preparation Ritual/Defensive Boon

items.name: Defensive Transmutation
items.description: When taking another shape, you can increase your defenses.

rulesData.text: When taking another shape, you can increase your defenses. Spend this boon's effect as a free action when you cast a transmutation spell with a range of personal. As long as you are affected by that spell, you gain a +2 natural armor bonus for the duration of the spell.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Mastering Magic/Spellbooks/Spellbooks/Tome of the Transmuter (Level 8 Transmuter)/Preparation Ritual/Defensive Transmutation

items.name: Eyes of Rul Thaven
items.description: You use a trick perfected by Rul Thaven to ferret out invisible creatures.

rulesData.text: You use a trick perfected by Rul Thaven to ferret out invisible creatures. Spend this boon's effect as a swift action. You gain the effects of see invisibility for 1 round.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Mastering Magic/Spellbooks/Spellbooks/Journeyman Book of Rul Thaven (Level 9 Diviner)/Preparation Ritual/Eyes of Rul Thaven

items.name: Glittering Eyes
items.description: When casting an illusion spell, you gain expanded sight.

rulesData.text: When casting an illusion spell, you gain expanded sight. Spend this boon's effect as a free action when you cast an illusion spell. You gain darkvision 60 feet and a +4 bonus on saving throws to disbelieve illusions, with both benefits lasting for 1 minute.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Mastering Magic/Spellbooks/Spellbooks/Grimoire of Glittering Eyes (Level 7 Illusionist)/Preparation Ritual/Glittering Eyes

items.name: Guardian Trick
items.description: With a quick phrase of power, you attempt to foil an attack.

rulesData.text: With a quick phrase of power, you attempt to foil an attack. Spend this boon's effect as an immediate action when an undead or outsider hits you with an attack. The attacking creature must reroll the attack, taking the second roll even if it is lower.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Mastering Magic/Spellbooks/Spellbooks/Guardian Grimoire (Level 15 Abjurer)/Preparation Ritual/Guardian Trick

items.name: Harmful Surge
items.description: You can maximize a spell, but doing so damages you.

rulesData.text: You can maximize a spell, but doing so damages you. Spend this boon effect as a free action when you cast a wizard evocation spell. When you do, you can treat that spell as if it were cast with the Maximize Spell metamagic feat, but you take 1d4 points of damage × the level of the spell that you are maximizing. The damage you take cannot be reduced in any way.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Mastering Magic/Spellbooks/Spellbooks/Book of Harms (Level 5 Evoker)/Preparation Ritual/Harmful Surge

items.name: Improved Eyes of Rul Thaven
items.description: This improved boon allows you to see invisible creatures.

rulesData.text: This improved boon allows you to see invisible creatures. You can activate the boon's effect as a swift action to gain the effects of see invisibility for up to 10 rounds. The rounds need not be consecutive, but you must spend a swift action each time you activate the boon's effect. The boon's effect is only spent when all 10 rounds of see invisibility are used up, or the next time you prepare wizard spells.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Mastering Magic/Spellbooks/Spellbooks/Master Books of Rul Thaven (Level 17 Diviner)/Preparation Ritual/Improved Eyes of Rul Thaven

items.name: Revivifying Contingency
items.description: You do not spend this boon with an action.

rulesData.text: You do not spend this boon with an action. When you are affected by this boon, the first time you are reduced to 0 or fewer hit points, you immediately regain 2d6 hit points. If this is enough for you to reach 0 hit points or higher, you do not fall unconscious.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Mastering Magic/Spellbooks/Spellbooks/Manual of Binding (Level 18 Conjurer)/Preparation Ritual/Revivifying Contingency

items.name: Rime Bite
items.description: You infuse your spell with a biting cold that few can withstand.

rulesData.text: You infuse your spell with a biting cold that few can withstand. Spend this boon as a free action when you cast a spell with the cold descriptor. Any damage from that spell ignores all resistance to cold, but does not ignore immunity to cold.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Mastering Magic/Spellbooks/Spellbooks/Arctic Call (Level 11 Evoker)/Preparation Ritual/Rime Bite

items.name: Shadow Knowledge
items.description: The knowledge in this book clings to your consciousness like the Shadow Plane itself.

rulesData.text: The knowledge in this book clings to your consciousness like the Shadow Plane itself. Unlike other boons, you do not spend this one. Until you prepare spells again, you are considered trained in all Knowledge skills as long as the check pertains to the geography and denizens of the Shadow Plane. If you are already trained in the appropriate Knowledge skill, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on these checks instead.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Mastering Magic/Spellbooks/Spellbooks/Mysteries of Shadow (Level 16 Illusionist)/Preparation Ritual/Shadow Knowledge

items.name: Spontaneous Bomb
items.description: When it comes to bombs, you have a special trick up your sleeve.

rulesData.text: When it comes to bombs, you have a special trick up your sleeve. Once per day as a swift action, you can apply a discovery that you qualify for (but do not already know) to a bomb. This does not allow you to stack non-stacking discoveries on a bomb.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Mastering Magic/Spellbooks/Spellbooks/The Formulae of Master Gebr (Level 20 Alchemist)/Preparation Ritual/Spontaneous Bomb

items.name: Sturdy Summoning
items.description: A creature you summon gains augmented defenses for a short time.

rulesData.text: A creature you summon gains augmented defenses for a short time. Spend this boon effect as a free action when you cast a conjuration (summoning) wizard spell. The creature you summon with that spell gains a number of temporary hit points equal to your caster level, and as long as the summoned creature has at least 1 of these hit points, it gains a +2 circumstance bonus on saving throws.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Mastering Magic/Spellbooks/Spellbooks/Insights of Far-Seeing Taernis (Level 12 Conjurer)/Preparation Ritual/Sturdy Summoning

items.name: Travel Sage
items.description: There is nothing like a magic book to enhance the memory.

rulesData.text: There is nothing like a magic book to enhance the memory. Unlike other boons, you do not spend this one. Until you prepare spells again, you are considered trained in Knowledge (geography). If you are already trained in Knowledge (geography), you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on those checks instead.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Mastering Magic/Spellbooks/Spellbooks/Quest Eternal (Level 13 Diviner)/Preparation Ritual/Travel Sage

items.name: Cheat Death
items.description: At 9th level, once per day, a reincarnated druid may reroll a save against a death effect, energy drain, or necromancy effect before the result of the roll is revealed, or reroll a failed stabilization check while dying.

rulesData.text: At 9th level, once per day, a reincarnated druid may reroll a save against a death effect, energy drain, or necromancy effect before the result of the roll is revealed, or reroll a failed stabilization check while dying. She must take the result of the second roll, even if it is worse than the original roll. This ability replaces venom immunity.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Druid/Druid Archetypes/Reincarnated Druid/Cheat Death

items.name: Many Lives
items.description: At 5th level, if a reincarnated druid is killed, she may automatically reincarnate (as the spell) 1 day later.

rulesData.text: At 5th level, if a reincarnated druid is killed, she may automatically reincarnate (as the spell) 1 day later. The reincarnated druid appears in a safe location within 1 mile of her previous body. At will for the next 7 days, she can sense the presence of her remains as if using locate object as a spell-like ability. If she is killed during these 7 days, she remains dead and does not reincarnate. The many lives ability does not function ifthe reincarnated druid is slain by a death effect. A reincarnated druid cannot be raised from the dead or resurrected, though she can be reincarnated.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Druid/Druid Archetypes/Reincarnated Druid/Many Lives

items.name: Mysterious Stranger
items.description: At 2nd level, a reincarnated druids adds 1/2 her druid level to the DC of Sense Motive, Diplomacy, and Knowledge checks to learn about her.

rulesData.text: At 2nd level, a reincarnated druids adds 1/2 her druid level to the DC of Sense Motive, Diplomacy, and Knowledge checks to learn about her. This ability replaces woodland stride.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Druid/Druid Archetypes/Reincarnated Druid/Mysterious Stranger

items.name: Resist Death's Touch
items.description: At 4th level, a reincarnated druid gains a +4 bonus on saving throws against death effects, energy drain, and necromancy effects, and on stabilization checks when dying.

rulesData.text: At 4th level, a reincarnated druid gains a +4 bonus on saving throws against death effects, energy drain, and necromancy effects, and on stabilization checks when dying. This ability replaces resist nature's lure.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Druid/Druid Archetypes/Reincarnated Druid/Resist Deaths Touch

items.name: Tongue of the Sun and Moon
items.description: At 15th level, a reincarnated druid can speak with any living creature.

rulesData.text: At 15th level, a reincarnated druid can speak with any living creature. This ability replaces timeless body.
rulesData.sourceReference: pfsrd://Ultimate Magic/Rules/Spellcasting Class Options/Druid/Druid Archetypes/Reincarnated Druid/Tongue of the Sun and Moon
